purpose: Sparse pale-pink sakura corner decoration; separated petals may be cropped in CSS for tiny divider accents.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent raster decorative corner asset for a pale pink galgame settings panel.
Primary request: a sparse, delicate cherry blossom twig entering from the top-right corner, curving down and left; only 2–3 small five-petaled sakura flowers plus a few clean separate falling petals.
Style: refined Japanese visual novel UI illustration, very fine smooth lines with soft pale watercolor petal shading, polished and clean at tiny interface sizes.
Composition: square canvas, twig and blossoms mainly in the upper-right quadrant, airy negative space over the remaining three quarters; petals separated enough to reuse small crops as divider accents. The branch enters at the right edge near the top, flowers face the viewer. Avoid a dense cluster.
Palette: extremely pale blush pink, pastel rose, slightly darker dusty-rose twig, tiny muted peach stamens; no dark black/brown outlines, no saturated magenta, no green leaves.
Background: true transparent alpha, no white or pink filled background, no baked checkerboard.
Constraints: single decorative asset only; no text, no letters, no UI, no icons, no frame, no logo, no drop shadow, no glow, no watermark.
